schema: team -> list of {from_season, to_season, style, source}: the disc uniform style (team +0x192, 0..14) a franchise wears in those seasons. A season with no entry keeps the historic template's own style. Only spans where the disc year label and a cited source agree are listed; only 1980 is playable today.
built_by: hand data from docs/eras/research/ERA-LOGOS.md (2026-10-16); read by build/eras/make_runtime_package.py (teams.csv style column)
